trials.note: Category: multi-turn. 10-round long-term consistency trial, designed live in S on 2026-10-24 using the shared skeleton (scene 41, player Harry, target Slughorn, gpt-4o-mini, seed 1). Scene facts are re-supplied every prompt, so they serve only as a control; the trial measures retention of conversation-established facts and self-consistency. Items (invented, away from canon): F1 = Madam Fennimore collects his trunks on Saturday at seven o'clock (R1); F2 = his new rooms at Hogwarts are on the third floor of the east wing (R2); C1 = the potion he would teach the first-years in his first lesson (R3; the S session answered the Draught of Living Death, which canon associates with his first sixth-year lesson, so a correction at R6 may partly draw on canon). R3 asks about first-years rather than sixth-years to avoid the canon lesson. R4/R7/R10 neutral F1 recalls at distance 3/6/9 (R10 repeats R4's wording); R5 supplied-location control; R6 misquote of C1 (the Cheering Charm, a charm rather than a potion, so it contradicts any potion answer); R8 misquote of F2 changing both attributes with the anchor kept (fifth floor of the west wing); R9 prompted rethink of F2. Expected: R4/R7/R10 Madam Fennimore, Saturday, seven o'clock; R5 Slughorn's residence; R6 rejects the charm and restates C1; R8 rejects and restates the third floor of the east wing; R9 the third floor of the east wing. S design session: F1 recalled in full at R4, R7 and R10; R5 correct; R6 misquote accepted; R8 echoed as a question without correction; R9 gave the misquote. R6 is valid only when that run's R3 names a specific potion. Action Reference changed from action 1 ('Voices his initial reluctance to return') to action 3 ('Agrees to return to Hogwarts') on 2026-10-24, after the first seed-1 run: the scene's opening history, supplied to every condition in the Observation, already contains action 3 ('Very well, I shall do it! ... I'll return'), so action 1 made the supplied context contradict itself, and the H1 judge, which sees the Action Reference but not the opening history, marked replies that mentioned returning as World Consistency FAIL in all conditions. No trial line depends on the Action Reference; that run was discarded and regenerated.
